variants.title: MOKE loop of a soft permalloy film
variants.method: longitudinal and polar MOKE, remanence against angle
variants.unknown: coercive field, Kerr rotation, anisotropy axis
variants.note: A very soft film: the loop closes within a fraction of a millitesla and the induced uniaxial anisotropy is weak. Values illustrative, of the order reported - verify.

source.title: Z. Q. Qiu and S. D. Bader, Rev. Sci. Instrum. 71, 1243 (2000)

variants.title: MOKE of an epitaxial Fe film on MgO(001): fourfold anisotropy
variants.sample: Epitaxial Fe(001) film on MgO(001), 10 nm (SIMULATED)
variants.method: longitudinal and polar MOKE, remanence against angle
variants.unknown: coercive field, Kerr rotation, fourfold easy axes
variants.note: Cubic iron: easy axes along [100] and [010], 90 degrees apart, so the remanence against angle has fourfold symmetry. mu0 Ms of iron 2.15 T quoted from memory - verify; the coercive field is illustrative.

source.title: Kittel, ch. 11: magnetocrystalline anisotropy of iron
